theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_rim_sub_imrep
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U C' : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (θ' : Euclid P → ℕ), MeasurableSet C' → C' ⊆ R.carrier → Measurable θ' → (∀ x ∈ C', 0 < θ' x) → (∀ x ∈ C', θ' x ≤ R.mult x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict C'), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R.carrier x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C' x Q) → ∃ R' : IMRep U n, R'.carrier = C' ∧ R'.mult = θ' ∧ R'.orient = R.orient
